sources.title: BrainOmni: A Brain Foundation Model for Unified EEG and MEG Signals
sources.snippet: The success of this foundation model suggests a promising future for brain-computer interfaces and neurological applications. The integration of multiple signal types and self-supervised learning points toward more sophisticated neural monitoring systems.
